text: Investigate your authentic feelings. Throughout the day, regularly ask yourself a simple question: “What am I feeling right now?”. It is informative and develops awareness. And, besides, your attention to the emotion being discovered will launch the process of its transformations, and bring you out of getting stuck in it for a long time... Becoming acquainted with your emotional life is a most important step toward de-automatization and reviving the anahata. When you master this practice, move to its advanced level - ask yourself the question: “What am I feeling for real, beneath the layer of the obvious emotion?”. Beneath irritation you may find fear. Beneath boredom - unrealized passion. Beneath calm - suppressed rage. Be ruthlessly honest in this investigation, go deep into yourself, harmonize yourself, heal yourself...
